entities.summary: Adolphe Nourrit was a French operatic tenor, librettist, and composer. One of the most esteemed opera singers of the 1820s and 1830s, he was particularly associated with the works of Gioachino Rossini and Giacomo Meyerbeer. Adolphe Nourrit was a composers & musicians from Montpellier (1802-03-03, Montpellier–1839-03-07). A moderately significant entity in the historical record. Relevant to cause-and-effect analysis.
